svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arms: two 30 mm tubes about 800 long, cut at 44 deg at the foot so they

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sit flat on the rail tops, the foot end against the front cross member.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cope the top end of each arm to the 33.7 mm bar (a saddle cut).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross bar: 33.7 x 2.6 mm tube 820 long, 800 above the ground and 550

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in front of the rail front ends; the arms meet it 125 from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grips: 95 mm rubber grips on both bar ends, pushed on with soapy water.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tack the arms to the frame in a jig, check, then weld all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bar level within 3 mm and square to the cart centre line.
